description: Step 1 of 3 of the file-upload flow: reserve an upload and mint a short-lived presigned S3 PUT URL. This is the ONLY way to get a file into stella from an agent surface; the multipart endpoints cannot be called with JSON. Pass purpose plus the file metadata: name, mimeType, size in bytes, and sha256Hex (lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact bytes). purpose is entity_create (with propertyId, optional parentId, and optional importOrigin to keep an imported file's source, id, original dates and author) to add a new document, entity_version (with entityId) to add a version to an existing one, or agent_skill (with scope team or private) for a skill pack. Returns uploadId, url, expiresAt, and headers. Step 2: PUT the bytes to url with those headers verbatim -- the URL is signed against the exact size and checksum, so any deviation is rejected. Step 3: call uploads.update with the uploadId to commit the record. Call uploads.delete instead if the PUT fails.

importOrigin.description: Set when the file is imported from another system, to keep its original dates, author and id as the version's provenance

authorName.description: The author as the source system recorded them, for authors who are not stella users

createdAt.description: When the file was created in the source system

modifiedAt.description: When the file was last modified in the source system

source.description: Lowercase source-system key (product or file-format name)
